# Authorized algorithm notice

This directory contains a small Python 3.8-compatible adaptation of the
deterministic recognition algorithms from `wx-doc-format-skill` version
`0.12.15`. The author has authorized AI-WPS to reuse the source locally.

Only the fixed source template asset and read-only recognition/audit behaviour
are included. The document conversion pipeline, rendering helpers, LLM
enhancement, and automatic formatting/write-back behaviour are not included.
AI-WPS compiled rule packs are the only authority for expected template values.
Source file hashes and the local adaptation boundary are recorded in
`SOURCE_MANIFEST.json`.
